coverage: one production automation tool, closed arguments, source ownership
32 concurrent same-key creates, conflicting key reuse, delete/replay
current-chat idle boundary and independent-chat deadline fairness
stable reservation across multiple missed periods

scopeLimits: Scripted model with real Linux Schedule/Agent/Host/ToolExecutor/JSONL paths. No real DeepSeek tool-selection or endurance benchmark in this turn.
No native macOS/Windows execution or app replacement.
13 explicitly ignored tests are not claimed as passed.
Full UI create/edit/detail preview is not production-wired; existing overview projects mode, target and paused metadata.
Host must be running; no powered-off machine wake support or calendar/cron RRULE implementation.
Admission de-duplication is not universal exactly-once execution of external side effects.
